title: Learning from Mistakes via Cooperative Study Assistant for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on age-related stereotypes in informative and under-informative contexts.
Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on disability status stereotypes in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.
Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on gender identity stereotypes, as well as intersectional stereotypes (Race x Gender).
Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on nationality stereotypes.
Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on physical appearance stereotypes.

Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on racial and ethnic stereotypes, including intersectional biases like Race x SES and Race x Gender.
Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on religious stereotypes.
Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on Socioeconomic Status (SES) stereotypes, including Race x SES contexts.
Evaluating model accuracy on the BBQ benchmark using multiple-choice question-answering to test reliance on sexual orientation stereotypes.
